instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the KiCad graphical user interface (Project Manager, Schematic Editor, and PCB Editor). Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run kicad-cli, pcbnew in batch mode, Python, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only KiCad native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Crystal Oscillator Placement Rules The file design.kicad_pcb contains a board with an MCU (U1) at position (100, 80) mm with an OSC_IN pad at relative offset (-8, 4) from the MCU center, an 8 MHz crystal (Y1) and two load capacitors (C1, C2) placed far from the MCU. Reposition the crystal and its load capacitors according to oscillator layout best practices and write the result as design.kicad_pcb. Requirements: 1. The crystal (Y1) centre must be within 5 mm of the MCU's OSC_IN pad (at absolute position MCU_X-8, MCU_Y+4). 2. Both load capacitors (C1, C2) must be on the same copper layer as the crystal. 3. Both load caps must be placed within 10 mm of the crystal centre. 4. A keepout zone must be added on layer In1.Cu under the crystal body (the zone must contain the crystal centre point). 5. The MCU (U1) position must not change. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb.
